children: Rixos Premium Dubai has unveiled its new Luxury Suite Collection, introducing 164 units ranging from one- to four-bedroom suites and four-bedroom penthouses as part of the hotel’s continued evolution.
The collection is designed for families, extended stays, special occasions and travellers seeking greater privacy and flexibility.
Each suite features dedicated living areas and panoramic views of JBR’s beachfront and Ain Dubai.

The residential-style concept combines additional space and privacy with personalised service, offering guests greater flexibility while retaining access to the hotel’s dining, entertainment, wellness and beachfront facilities.
Rixos Premium Dubai’s venues include Godiva, Turquoise, Lock, Stock & Barrel and Azure Beach.
The offering is set to expand with Josephine, a Mediterranean-inspired dining destination, and Kapitol, a new entertainment and social hub.
Selected Luxury Suite Collection guests will also have access to Studio X, a private performance and wellness studio focused on training, recovery and wellbeing.
Facilities include one-to-one coaching, precision training, Pilates Reformer and dedicated recovery experiences, supported by PENT. equipment and residential-inspired interiors.

The new collection forms part of Rixos Premium Dubai’s broader accommodation strategy, expanding its suite offering while complementing its established dining, entertainment, wellness and beachfront experiences.

The suites provide guests with a more residential approach to their stay, catering to different travel needs while allowing them to experience the hotel’s wider facilities and services within one beachfront destination.

title: ZAWYA: Rixos Premium Dubai unveils new Luxury Suite Collection
